items.q: How hot can a PP loop be sanitized?
items.a: Hot water runs no higher than [maximum loop sanitization temperature for PP, °C]; natural PP is rated to 80 °C. Above that we quote PVDF, or sanitize chemically.
L from the main pipe inside wall to the valve seal point, D the branch inside diameter, at every tee and sample valve. Every branch is in the dead leg register.

items.q: How do you keep flow turbulent when several outlets open?
items.a: We size pipe and pump for the worst-case outlet combination, not the average. At SAT we open those outlets together and record return flow.

items.q: How do you prove there is no ozone at the point of use?
items.a: An ozone sensor after the UV destruct unit stops supply on breakthrough. Water is tested for residual ozone after each sanitization. The interlock is tested at FAT and OQ.

items.q: Can you add points of use to an existing loop?
items.a: Yes, after a hydraulic check at the new peak draw. Each branch is cut in with [PP point-of-use valve type] under your change control. Shutdown: [typical shutdown for a point-of-use addition, days].
